script: She threw her entire cart on the floor, yelled at me, and stormed out—what happened next?. It was the day I was still learning the checkout dance, so I was way slower than the usual cashier flow. The store was packed, a line like a river of shoppers, and I kept hitting items that wouldn't scan. One coworker was juggling the tech support, so we called a manager to open a new register. We were still pulling the right code when a woman in front of us—she was like, "I am not here to wait!"—tossed her pool noodles and towels onto the floor and stormed out, yelling at me with names that sounded like a bad playlist. I felt the heat, but honestly, it only took us 2‑3 minutes. There was another register open that could've saved her time. (I know, right?) The audacity of her reaction? (Literally insane.)
